injuryJourney.intro: We check safety first. Then we show you what to preserve and how to continue without giving a diagnosis or identity.
injuryJourney.privacy: Your answers are used only to guide you on this page. They are not saved or sent.
injuryJourney.title: Are you in danger now, do you need urgent help, or are you unsure?

urgent.title: Your safety comes first.
urgent.body: Do not continue organizing the case until you are out of danger and have the help you need.
urgent.emergency: Contact local emergency services. In the European Union, you can call 112 free of charge. Outside the EU, use the local emergency number.

source.title: How did the injury happen?
source.hint: Choose the situation that best describes what happened; we do not ask for a diagnosis.

referral.treatmentBody: Preserve documents you already have and seek advice from an appropriate professional. Interdomestik does not promise handling or recovery for this category.
referral.assaultTitle: Safety and specialist support come first.
referral.assaultBody: If danger continues, contact local emergency services. Seek specialist local support before organizing a claim.
referral.unsureTitle: You can begin without knowing the category.
referral.unsureBody: Preserve the date, place, and facts you already know. Seek professional guidance when the situation is unclear; this page does not decide whether a claim exists.

countries.incidentTitle: In which country did the incident happen?
countries.incidentHint: You confirm this yourself; we do not infer it from language, residence, or location.
countries.residenceTitle: In which country do you usually live?
countries.residenceHint: This may be different from the country where the incident happened.

evidence.title: Preserve the facts you may need.
evidence.body: When you are safe, preserve these general facts. This is not a diagnosis, liability assessment, or promise of compensation.

items.incident: The date, place, and incident report, if one was provided.
items.costs: Bills and costs connected with the incident.
items.impact: A timeline of the financial and practical impact.

evidence.diasporaTitle: Did the incident happen outside the country where you live?
evidence.diasporaBody: The incident country and residence stay separate so cross-border context is clear, without giving a legal conclusion.
evidence.handoff: The established Free Start intake begins now. None of these orientation answers are carried over; you choose what to submit.
